data.one_liner: A customizable carousel/slider widget with indicator positioning, text overlay, and 3D effects.
data.what_it_does: Provides several carousel styles including standard, 3D, wheel gallery, and coverflow. Allows zoom, indicator effects, and overlay text with configurable positions.
use_when: You need a feature‑rich image carousel with custom indicator and text overlays
You want built‑in 3D or wheel‑gallery effects without writing custom animations
avoid_when: You only need a simple static image slider
You require tight integration with a specific backend or state‑management solution
strengths: Multiple built‑in carousel styles (3D, wheel, coverflow)
weaknesses: Relies on additional packages (smooth_page_indicator, zoom_hover_pinch_image) which increase bundle size
No explicit support for lazy loading or huge data sets
data.minimal_example:
CarouselCustomSlider(
  autoPlay:true,
  sliderList:myImages,
  effect:SwapEffect(
    dotHeight:12,
    dotWidth:12,
    type:SwapType.yRotation,
    activeDotColor:Colors.blue,
    dotColor:Colors.grey,
  ),
);
